findings.detail: Fixture MFA Web login uses the protected browser-cookie session rather than a native bearer token. The native fixture had no cookie/CSRF headers.
findings.fix: Use the actual Android bearer MFA session for native calls; the independent actual browser check performs its own ordinary Web login/cookie/CSRF flow.

findings.detail: The derived-retirement trigger referenced files.project_id, but actual file scope is inherited from its folder. Native diagnostics reported PostgreSQL42703.
findings.fix: Resolve the exact current folder and use its project scope with the current session channel for ordinary read/manage checks.
